title: Utilization rollup by redistribution window (Apr 24-30 2026)
summary: Weekly sheet export used to feed the redistribution window. Focused on per-cluster / per-pool utilization, short-term headroom projections, and candidate pools for redistribution/burst. Includes flags for clusters where p95 > 85% or queue growth > 20% day-over-day.
content:
Notes:
- Export pulled from 'utilization-dashboard' API + pool allocator logs at 04:00 UTC each day for 2026-04-24 through 2026-04-30.
- Window sizing: 6h rolling windows aggregated to daily averages, plus p95 and max.
- Purpose: quick triage for redistribution run on Mon 2026-05-03 (target refill risky pools, enable burst on low-cost pools).
- Short-hand markers: RED = critical (p95 >= 90% or queue growth >= 40%), YLW = watch (p95 80-90% or queue growth 20-40%), GRN = healthy.

Operational action items (recommended):
1) Consider moving 24 slots from pool 'batch-fast-eu-west-2' -> 'ondemand-eu-west-2' (see rows flagged). Potential savings: ~6% per-token by moving to smaller-quantized instance family during non-peak.
2) Hold redistribution on cluster 'na-cluster-13' until kube-scheduler bug JIRA-INF-4512 patched (preempt spikes observed).
3) Add prefix cache snapshot to 'ml-training-apac' pools to reduce cold-start token costs; prototype in dev.

Anomalies flagged in this export:
- na-cluster-07: sustained p95 spike on 2026-04-27 (p95 93%) correlated with a single customer job that had runaway sequence lengths. Jira created: JIRA-INF-4561.
- eu-cluster-02/pool-realtime: queue growth +48% day-over-day on 2026-04-29 (RED). Investigate routing fallback triggers.

Interpretation notes:
- Avg util is a strong function of daytime cadence in NA vs EU; use p95 for headroom planning.
- "headroom_gpus" is computed as floor((target_slo_util_pct - p95_util_pct) / target_slo_util_pct * capacity_gpus). Negative headroom indicates overcommit risk.

CSV rows included below are: date,region,cluster_id,pool_name,capacity_gpus,avg_util_pct,p95_util_pct,max_util_pct,headroom_gpus,queued_jobs,queue_growth_pct,preempt_rate_pct,marker,notes
